module_summary: Serial UART-style byte receiver: a 12-state FSM tracks start, 8 data bits and stop bit while a 10-bit shift register captures the bits.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Receiver FSM: idle/start, eight data-bit states, stop check, done and error recovery.

anchors.name: byte_r
anchors.why: 10-bit shift register shifting in serial bits LSB-first; bits [8:1] form the byte.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Asserted in DONE state; qualifies out_byte as valid.

anchors.name: out_byte
anchors.why: Received data byte taken from shift register, valid only when done.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Serial input line feeding both the FSM transitions and the shift register.

groups.name: rx_controller
groups.description: Bit-sequencing FSM checking start/stop bits and generating done.

groups.name: rx_shift_register
groups.description: Deserializes the input line into a byte for out_byte.
